title: Concentration: solute per volume
caption: Both beakers hold the same volume of solution, but the right one has twice as many dissolved particles, so it is twice as concentrated. Concentration = amount of solute ÷ volume of solution.
alt: Two beakers filled to the same level; the left has five dissolved copper ions, the right ten.
description: Right: same volume, 10 solute particles, twice the concentration.
